notes.title: The final chapter of One Day in London is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/e60c066aa7aa827a48270fe7c75fef05728e0bed.jpg[/img]

It’s finally happening! We have been working on the final chapter for a long time, and we are finally ready to share it with you! 

The outcome of the story is completely dependent on the decisions YOU made in the previous chapters. Everything is connected – every phrase and decision has consequences, whether the deaths of loved ones or finding powerful allies. It’s finally time to defy your inner fears and those otherworldly creatures! Immerse yourself in the grim underworld of 1888 London with the final chapter of One Day in London!

We sincerely thank you again for playing One Day in London, and we are always happy to receive your comments, reviews or opinions.
If you notice any bugs or mistakes in our game, please do not hesitate to contact us and we’ll get right on with correcting them!
You can contact us at info@owl-studio.net.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/dfcf9401bc8a6347a0d58bcd44a934d71cd00cbf.jpg[/img]

Dear Friends, 
We are finally ready to announce the release date of the final chapter of One Day in London on Steam — May 17, 2018!

Next week, you will be able to return to your thrilling adventures in occult London — where new secrets and long-desired answers await. Everything is in your hands — how the story ends depends entirely on your decisions.

We would just like to say that we are extremely grateful to all of you for choosing us, believing in us and staying with us on this journey. Without your feedback, suggestions, stories and fan art, One Day in London would not be what it is today. From the bottom of our hearts, thank you!

Yours Sincerely,
OWL Studio

notes.title: Release day is approaching!
The Fifth Chapter is coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/7056c87786cbfb84789d769ce416832f17b01ccc.png[/img]

Hooray, guys!

We are going to release the fifth chapter of One Day in London.  We have drawn all the art, finished mini-games and complement it by proper music and sounds. All the storylines are coming to their logical conclusion.

We have compiled the build of the fifth chapter and now we begin to test the whole game to get a high-quality product as a result. The actions of the protagonist in previous chapters will directly influence the finale of the game. So, we test not only the fifth chapter but the whole game. We plan to release the game next week barring any unforeseen difficulties.

The fifth chapter is going to be the most dynamic one. You will play it in one breath! We are also increase the replay value of One Day in London by working through every storyline in order to prolong your pleasure.

We added fast-forward mode for your comfort. It will be available for any completed episode. The mode will automatically turn off when the events come to the ‘story fork’. So, you won't miss anything! No annoying clicking — only you, the story and the music.

Moreover, we're proof-reading texts of the previous chapters. Now the story starts shining with new colors as the quality of text increased.

We will announce details of all new features next week.

And, above all, we will improve the game with updating versions even after the fifth chapter release. We want you to enjoy our game.

Yours sincerely
OWL Studio

P.S.: Follow our news!

notes.title: The Fourth Chapter is available!
notes.notes:
Today we released the Fourth Chapter on Steam!

A lot of things have changed since the final of the Third Chapter. After all the trials Jeremy became a different person. But not only Jeremy – his friends and even London have changed influenced by the villain. It seems that there is almost no chance to win… And the Final Battle is already very close! After the release of the Fourth Chapter we take on the development of the Last Chapter, the fifth part of our Story. 

Write us your reviews, send your letters to our e-mail or pigeons to our office! We look forward to your impressions.

During the first weekend after the release you can get the Chapter at a discount of 30%!
Together with the discount of 10% on the first three Chapters that will last until the 29th of August, - this is a very good chance to get acquaintance or to acquaint somebody with our Game until the release of the final.

It's full of new interesting things. Chase scenes, bloody rituals and shootings are ahead! You will meet new characters, find out more about the old ones, and Jeremy will finally face his archenemy...

The third chapter is available via downloadable content for $5.99.

notes.title: Third episode is almost here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25890156/2346840066bfdcd3303dba5894d70e38c5bdc8c1.png[/img]
Dear players!
Since the release of the second episode we have done a very big job.
 
Another update is coming up! We have significantly improved the game engine, so our work has become easier. It's better optimized now, so the development of future episodes is bound to speed up. Besides, now we can create even more different and engaging mini-games!
We have also added a startup menu and completely redesigned the save-game system, so every day may now be loaded separately. In order to avoid potential problems, upon the first start of the game you will be transferred to the beginning of the latest day saved.
Two new episodes on the new engine will be published first.But don't you worry! The third episode will arrive soon and will be available as a paid update to the basic game.
It is larger than the first two volumes combined! New locations, new characters, mini-games, and, of course, the continuation of the story! Your actions in the second episode will greatly affect the third one and open a way to a variety of alternative plots! Where will your choice bring you? Which consequences will you have to face? You will find it out soon!

We are always happy to receive your feedback! We hope that you will love the new episode just like the previous ones.
